scripts.example: pnpm run example:rspack && pnpm run example:rsbuild
scripts.example:rspack: pnpm run build && node examples/rspack/build.mjs all && node scripts/compare-output-files.mjs --before examples/rspack/dist/css-loader --after examples/rspack/dist/builtin-css --extensions css --require-graph --check --out examples/rspack/dist/report.md
scripts.example:rsbuild: pnpm run build && node examples/rsbuild/build.mjs all && node scripts/compare-output-files.mjs --before examples/rsbuild/dist/css-loader --after examples/rsbuild/dist/builtin-css --extensions css --require-graph --check --out examples/rsbuild/dist/report.md
